reason: Matches a state (`[checked]`, `[disabled]`, `[expanded]`, `[pressed]`, `[selected]`, `[invalid]`) or a heading's `[level=N]` on a node; Expect.toMatchAria's AriaPattern names a node by role, name and children only, and the snapshot node's level isn't a field a pattern can read
Asserts that a page's tree does not match a template with `expect(page).not`; Expect.toMatchAria has no negated form, and a Condition can't ask a pattern's match without a comparison written by hand
Checks a link's `/url` line against a regular expression; Strider's snapshot node carries no link URL, and AriaPattern can't name one

Tests Playwright's template syntax: its escaping of names in quotes, `/…/` literals and YAML scalars (AR-128), its indentation of template text (AR-133), and its fallback for a regular expression that doesn't compile, kept as text (AR-141); a Strider pattern takes a JavaScript string or RegExp, so there is no template text to escape, indent or fall back from

Tests the YAML parse errors and attribute-value errors of Playwright's template (a sequence without its dashes, nested compact mappings, unterminated strings and regular expressions, unsupported or malformed attributes); a Strider pattern is typed data, and there is no template to parse
